newsitem.title: USA: U.S blue chips tumble as investors look beyond Dow.
newsitem.headline: U.S blue chips tumble as investors look beyond Dow.

text.p: The Dow industrials skidded to sharp losses on Wednesday amid signs investors were starting to seek opportunities beyond the blue chip arena.
The Dow fell 120 points to close unofficially at 7842. Broader indexes dodged the steep decline, however, and the Nasdaq Composite finished higher, lifted by a strong showing in technology stocks.
Early in the session, the Dow staged two separate runs at the 8,000 mark, topping out both times fewer than 10 points shy of the millennium mark.
